Author: dajoey
Name: PvP Solver
Description: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Changelog:
v0.1.2.33 (2026-11-21)
- Commands/RSCommands_Actions.cs UpdateRotationState: "Turn on when a match starts" could never engage - it only ran during the match loading screen, when no player object exists and the job role is unknown, so the null-player early return and the job-role check silently dropped it and the rotation loaded but never acted in matches. The auto-on now latches during the load screen (new pure decision core Basic/Decisions/MatchStartAutoOn.cs) and engages the PvP state on the first cycle where the player and job are loaded, logging both steps.
- RotationSolverPlugin.cs constructor and Commands/RSCommands_BasicInfo.cs RSCommands.Enable: the /pvpsolver, /pvs, "/pvpsolver Auto" and "/pvpsolver Off" handlers were registered only near the end of a 10-30 second start-up (after nine windows, the icon cache and the status lists), so commands typed while the plugin was still starting read as "Command not found". Registration now runs first, right after the configuration loads, and a start-up log line lists every command and its registration result.
- Commands/RSCommands_StateSpecialCommand.cs UpdateState and DoOneCommandType: rotation state changes and ignored role-less commands are logged, so a state that silently never engages can no longer hide behind a clean log.
- tests/PvPSolver.RotationHarness Cases/MatchStartAutoOnCases.cs and Cases/CommandGate.cs: the release harness now fails the build when a documented slash command has no registration call site in the built assembly (IL call-site count, not just source text), when the constructor no longer registers before the slow init steps, or when the match-start auto-on decision core cannot engage from the loading-screen conditions the shipped bug produced.

v0.1.2.32 (2026-11-21) [testing]
- Fixed: rotations never loaded, so the plugin did nothing in PvP matches since v0.1.2.26. The duty-rotation engine removal (v0.1.2.23) had also removed the single call in Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs LoadBuiltInRotations that fills CustomRotations from the assembly scan (LoadCustomRotationGroup); the rotation list stayed empty, the log stopped right after "MajorUpdater: triggering rotation load..." and no rotation was ever selected, with no error line anywhere.
- Restored that call and the "LoadBuiltInRotations: found N rotation groups" log line; a scan that finds no rotation groups now logs an error instead of staying silent (Updaters/RotationUpdater.cs, LoadBuiltInRotations).
- Added a release-harness gate (tests/PvPSolver.RotationHarness, RotationLoaderWiring) that fails when the rotation-load wiring is severed or the shipped assembly contains no loadable rotation - the regression class that passed every existing gate in v0.1.2.26 - v0.1.2.31.
- No PvE rotation content or behaviour returns; the PvP-only scope is unchanged. Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

- Kept on purpose: ObjectHelper.IsEnemy still probes hostility with the generic Blizzard action and ActionManagerHelper still reads the recast of the generic Heated Split Shot, because no PvP action id is proven to behave the same for those two probes.
